## ERC-8004 refusal ledger (read-only probe over the Base Identity Registry)

Registry eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432. Refusals named by limb,
pinned to a block, sample seed published. Not a reputation score and no ranking.

- https://kaydeep0.github.io/eigenstate-research/erc8004/  (human summary)
